title: palcheck routes the 48-vs-40 threshold on pr[0] color-VALUE equality, not pair identity — a signal pair whose first color happens to equal a map token value gets the laxer 40 threshold
detail: Threshold selection keys on the color value; any future mode where a signal-pair first color coincides with water/park/coast/canvas silently relaxes its threshold from 48 to 40.
recommended_fix: Track pair kind (signal vs map) alongside each appended pair and branch on that, not color equality.

title: Harness T2 capture computes the crisis banner_y from RAW constants while the app hud-scales it — the x1.50 golden path under-pins app banner placement
evidence:
banner_y: i32 = 10
...
		banner_y = 10 + rnd.HEALTH_CARD_H + 6
...
	rnd.draw_crisis_banner(&rc.view, crisis, rc.view.catalogs, era, banner_y)
detail: The capture draw path never threads ui_scale; the a11y_scale x1.50 golden bakes an unscaled banner position the app never draws.
recommended_fix: Route the capture banner_y through rnd.hud(&rc.view, ...) like the app draw path.

title: Demo a11y parser silently ignores trailing tokens after 'reduced' and after 'palette <mode>' — a typo like 'a11y reduced off' pins reduced=true with no error
detail: Both branches validate a minimum length but never a maximum; extra fields (e.g. 'reduced off', 'palette deutan tritan') are silently accepted.
recommended_fix: Reject len(fields) != expected in the palette and reduced branches, like the scale branch's value check.

title: modal_blocks_world check never asserts the selection-intact state its own comment claims — the suppressed-demolish path's side effect on sel_pipe is unobserved
detail: Only panel_open is checked; if a future regression clears sel_pipe on suppressed X, this scenario still passes.
recommended_fix: Assert runs[i].sel_pipe == 0 per device alongside panel_open.

title: panel_adjust_row recorded per device but never asserted — the row-index path of the adjust dispatch is unobserved
evidence:
panel_adjust_row: i32, // the LAST recorded adjust row
...
		panel_adjust_row = settings_rec.adjust_row if settings_rec != nil else -1,
detail: Parity_Run captures panel_adjust_row but no check_states branch reads it; an adjust dispatched on the wrong row passes parity.
recommended_fix: In the settings_panel check, assert runs[i].panel_adjust_row == 1.

title: Parity suite never runs under any a11y mode or ui_scale — input paths while a palette/reduced/x1.50 view is active are unexercised
location: harness/parity.odin (drive_parity / run_input_parity: view always Off, ui_scale 1.0)
detail: drive_parity and run_input_parity construct the view with defaults only; chip/row hit rects at x1.50 and modal gating under modes have no parity leg.
recommended_fix: Run the settings scenarios once per mode/scale step (view_compute with ui_scale set), or un-pin the per-mode parity claim.

title: a11y_reduced and a11y_scale goldens have no presence/content oracle — palcheck section 4 scans only the three palette-mode goldens
detail: The reduced-motion (static crisis) and x1.50-scale content contracts are unverified paths — only the T2 hash pins them.
recommended_fix: Extend the presence scan to a11y_reduced/a11y_scale frames (e.g. banner/glyph presence, scaled-chip pixel check).
